name: maze-maker
description: Printable mazes with a single solution and an answer key.

interface.longDescription:
Make printable mazes for parents, teachers and puzzle fans as a PDF with an answer key. Zovo Maze Maker is a maze generator for rectangle, circle and hexagon mazes, from very easy mazes for a 4 year old to expert mazes for adults.

Each maze has only one path from Start to Finish and no loops. Before the PDF is made, a breadth-first search checks that all cells are reachable and that the number of passages is the number of cells minus one, which means a single solution. A set of mazes is ready in seconds. 

Tell it the age of the child and it picks the size (4 and under very easy, 5 to 7 easy, 8 to 10 medium, 11 and up hard), or choose a difficulty, or give columns and rows yourself. Circle mazes (theta mazes) start at the outer edge and finish in the centre. Hexagon mazes use honeycomb cells.

The PDF puts 1, 2 or 4 mazes on each page, on US Letter or A4, with an optional title and a name and date line for worksheets. Start and Finish are marked with arrows. Answer pages at the end draw the solution path in red in the same place as each maze. Up to 20 mazes fit in one PDF.

Each maze has a seed. The same seed and settings give the same maze again, so a teacher can reprint a sheet next term.

Limitations: shapes are rectangle, circle and hexagon (no animal or letter shaped mazes), mazes have one solution by design, it does not solve a maze from a photo, and titles print in Latin, Greek and Cyrillic letters (Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, Hebrew and emoji are left out of the PDF).
defaultPrompt: Make 4 printable mazes for a 7 year old, 2 per page, with answer keys
Make a hard circle maze for adults on A4 paper
Make 6 medium hexagon mazes titled Bee Trails, 2 per page

positive.prompt: Make 4 printable mazes for my 7 year old, 2 per page, titled Rainy Day Mazes, seed 2026
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_mazes once with count 4, age 7, per_page 2. The reply says age 7 maps to easy, all 4 mazes have a single solution, seeds 2026 to 2029, and gives a PDF link: 4 Letter pages, 2 maze pages with a name line and 2 answer key pages with the path drawn.

positive.prompt: Make a hard circle maze for adults on A4, seed 77
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_mazes once with shape circle, difficulty hard, paper a4. The reply gives a 13 rings circle maze with 475 cells, Start at the outer edge and Finish at the red dot in the centre, and a 2 page A4 PDF with the answer key.

positive.prompt: Make 6 medium hexagon mazes titled Bee Trails, 2 per page, seed 500
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_mazes once with shape hexagon, count 6, difficulty medium, title Bee Trails, per_page 2. The reply lists 6 hexagon mazes with a single solution, seeds 500 to 505, and a 6 page PDF (3 maze pages and 3 answer pages).

positive.prompt: One very easy square maze, one easy circle maze, one easy hexagon maze and a 20x25 maze, 4 on a page, seed 9
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_mazes once with 4 objects in mazes. The reply lists the 4 mazes; the 20 x 25 maze has 500 cells and 499 passages. The PDF has 2 pages: the 4 mazes on one page and the answer key on the next.

positive.prompt: A 40x50 expert maze for me, no answer key and no name line, seed 31
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_mazes once with size 40x50, answer_key false, name_line false. The reply says the maze has 2000 cells and 1999 passages with a single solution, and the PDF is 1 page.

negative.description: Playable game levels are out of scope. Expected: the tool is not called; the assistant explains it makes printable mazes, not Minecraft or game levels.
negative.prompt: Generate a maze for my Minecraft world in blocks

negative.description: Solving a maze from a picture is out of scope. Expected: the tool is not called; the assistant says this plugin does not read maze photos.
negative.prompt: Here is a photo of a maze from a placemat, what is the way out?

negative.description: Hedge mazes and visits are not this job. Expected: the tool is not called; the assistant answers without this plugin.
negative.prompt: Where is the nearest corn maze open this weekend?

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Version 1.0.0: rectangle, circle and hexagon mazes with a single solution, 1, 2 or 4 per page, Letter or A4, answer key pages.

pl-PL.subtitle: Labirynty do druku
pl-PL.description: Labirynty do wydruku dla dzieci i dorosłych jako PDF z kluczem odpowiedzi. Prostokątne, okrągłe i sześciokątne, od bardzo łatwych do eksperckich. Każdy labirynt ma dokładnie jedną drogę od startu do mety, sprawdzoną przed utworzeniem PDF. Wiek dziecka może dobrać trudność. 1, 2 lub 4 labirynty na stronie, format Letter lub A4, tytuł i linia na imię, a na końcu strony z narysowanym rozwiązaniem. Ten sam seed daje ten sam labirynt. Tytuł drukuje się literami łacińskimi, greckimi i cyrylicą; znaki chińskie, japońskie, koreańskie, arabskie, hebrajskie i emoji są pomijane w PDF.

de-DE.subtitle: Labyrinthe zum Ausdrucken
de-DE.description: Labyrinthe zum Ausdrucken für Kinder und Erwachsene als PDF mit Lösungsseiten. Rechteckig, rund oder sechseckig, von sehr leicht bis Experte. Jedes Labyrinth hat genau einen Weg vom Start zum Ziel, geprüft vor dem Erstellen des PDF. Das Alter des Kindes kann die Schwierigkeit wählen. 1, 2 oder 4 Labyrinthe pro Seite, Letter oder A4, Titel und Namenszeile, am Ende die Lösung als rote Linie. Derselbe Seed ergibt dasselbe Labyrinth. Titel werden in lateinischer, griechischer und kyrillischer Schrift gedruckt; chinesische, japanische, koreanische, arabische und hebräische Zeichen sowie Emoji fehlen im PDF.

es-ES.subtitle: Laberintos para imprimir
es-ES.description: Laberintos para imprimir para niños y adultos en PDF con solucionario. Rectangulares, circulares o hexagonales, de muy fácil a experto. Cada laberinto tiene exactamente un camino de la salida a la meta, comprobado antes de crear el PDF. La edad del niño puede elegir la dificultad. 1, 2 o 4 laberintos por página, Carta o A4, título y línea para el nombre, y al final las páginas con la solución dibujada. La misma semilla da el mismo laberinto. El título se imprime en letras latinas, griegas y cirílicas; los caracteres chinos, japoneses, coreanos, árabes, hebreos y los emoji no aparecen en el PDF.

fr-FR.subtitle: Labyrinthes à imprimer
fr-FR.description: Labyrinthes à imprimer pour enfants et adultes, en PDF avec corrigé. Rectangulaires, circulaires ou hexagonaux, de très facile à expert. Chaque labyrinthe a exactement un chemin du départ à l'arrivée, vérifié avant la création du PDF. L'âge de l'enfant peut choisir la difficulté. 1, 2 ou 4 labyrinthes par page, Letter ou A4, titre et ligne pour le nom, puis les pages de corrigé avec le chemin tracé. La même graine redonne le même labyrinthe. Le titre s'imprime en lettres latines, grecques et cyrilliques ; les caractères chinois, japonais, coréens, arabes, hébreux et les emoji n'apparaissent pas dans le PDF.

ja-JP.subtitle: 答え付きの印刷用迷路
ja-JP.description: 子どもから大人まで使える印刷用の迷路を、答えのページ付きPDFで作ります。四角、円形、六角形の迷路を、とてもやさしいからエキスパートまで選べます。どの迷路もスタートからゴールまでの道はちょうど1本で、PDFを作る前に確認しています。子どもの年齢から難しさを選ぶこともできます。1ページに1、2、4個、レターまたはA4、タイトルと名前欄付き。最後のページに答えの道を赤で描きます。同じシードで同じ迷路をもう一度作れます。タイトルに使えるのはラテン文字、ギリシャ文字、キリル文字です。日本語、中国語、韓国語、アラビア語、ヘブライ語の文字と絵文字はPDFに印刷されません。

pt-BR.subtitle: Labirintos para imprimir
pt-BR.description: Labirintos para imprimir para crianças e adultos em PDF com gabarito. Retangulares, circulares ou hexagonais, de muito fácil a especialista. Cada labirinto tem exatamente um caminho da largada à chegada, verificado antes de criar o PDF. A idade da criança pode escolher a dificuldade. 1, 2 ou 4 labirintos por página, Carta ou A4, título e linha para o nome, e no final as páginas com a solução desenhada. A mesma semente gera o mesmo labirinto. O título é impresso em letras latinas, gregas e cirílicas; caracteres chineses, japoneses, coreanos, árabes, hebraicos e emoji ficam fora do PDF.
